quotes.text: I saw that Enriquez had made no attempt to modernize the old casa, and that even the garden was left in its lawless native luxuriance.
quotes.reference: 1896, Bret Harte, Stories in Light and Shadow:

quotes.text: Chuffy: WHAT? No, no, no, no, no. My casa is your casa, what?
